summary: Standards: three planted-violation wrappers (atip_checkl1_34, atip_check_42, atip_check_75) now 'exec' canon directly for any invocation naming dashboard, so the planted violation is never applied to the dashboard document; the dashboard run is covered only by the unmodified canon run. Also atip_check_107 (check-1-2) failed once for me under load average ~30 (panic at tests/support/mod.rs:58) and passed alone in 49 s; the evidence also needed a retry. Blast radius: a hint/null/example violation in dashboard's envelope would not be caught by those three tests; the load flake is in the harness, not in notRun.
